consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly agree that the 1983-10-15 show at Hartford Civic Center is one of the best performances of the year, showcasing tight musicianship and high energy throughout. The standout moments include a powerful rendition of St. Stephen and an exceptional second set featuring China>Rider and Playin'.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 84 reviews + 1.5 sentiment: The overall enthusiasm and praise for the performance, particularly the standout songs, significantly elevate the sentiment from a neutral baseline.
